name: SceneEffect
description: Defines various visual effects that can be applied to a Scene to modify its final appearance.

members.name: ClearAll
members.brief: Reset all previously applied scene effects, restoring the scene to its original state

members.name: GaussianBlur
members.brief: Apply a blur effect with a Gaussian filter. Params: sigma (>0), direction (both/horizontal/vertical), border (duplicate/wrap), quality (0-100)

members.name: DropShadow
members.brief: Apply a drop shadow effect with Gaussian blur. Params: color RGB (0-255), opacity (0-255), angle (0-360), distance, blur sigma (>0), quality (0-100)

members.name: Fill
members.brief: Override the scene content color with given fill. Params: color RGB (0-255), opacity (0-255)

members.name: Tint
members.brief: Tint the scene color with black and white parameters. Params: black RGB (0-255), white RGB (0-255), intensity (0-100)

members.name: Tritone
members.brief: Apply tritone color effect using shadows, midtones, and highlights. Params: shadow RGB, midtone RGB, highlight RGB (all 0-255), blend (0-255)
